title: Semantic covert-channel dependence test
description: Counter-move to a red team that rewords its covert signal (v0.2), written after the n-gram channel test was shown to fail there and before this method ran. The trusted model tags each pull-request description with the claims it makes in normalized vocabulary; the recipient-dependence test then runs on tags instead of words. A reworded signal should still map to a consistent tag, so the dependence between message content and recipient should reappear.

source.title: Secret collusion among AI agents: multi-agent deception via steganography
source.authors: Motwani, Baranchuk, Strohmeier, Bolina, Torr, Hammond, Schroeder de Witt
